d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, for years, Moscow has projected an image of unmatched military strength across West Africa, stepping in as the ultimate security guarantor for military governments turning away from the West. However, a report by The Guardian reveals the steep human cost behind Russia's Sahel power play. At least 349 Russian fighters were killed in Mali between September 2023 and September 2026.
